boundaries.existingForms: Pod, Service, ConfigMap, Secret and PVC unchanged
boundaries.pv: Static unbound NFS only; source and volumeMode lock in edit. Class/access changes affect binding. Capacity edit requires baseline and cannot decrease; it never resizes storage. Bound/provisioned volumes inspect-only.
boundaries.endpoints: Live sanitized same-name Service lookup must report serviceSelector:none; manual values retained; no companion Service.
boundaries.actions: Node workflows and Event involved objects use the existing discovery-backed ResourceLinkChip navigation. No invented action protocol or execution claim. Existing workflows own drain/cordon/taint/finalize/token/scale and pod streams.
boundaries.sensitive: Annotation values, inline container env/command/args, PV mount options/CSI attributes/flex options, event messages and component health messages/errors stay masked. No raw source capture.
boundaries.source: Only canonical atomic leaf set/remove/insert. No projected subtree writeback.
